name: Chef Hand-off for MDL3
description: Lets Chef Shared Loader (and the mods made for it, such as HUDdle) run next to MDL3. With MDL3 above Chef the game runs MDL3's boot and Chef never starts; this addon, started by MDL3, hands the game to Chef a few seconds after the game starts (the hand-off in Chef's own documentation, 'For other loaders'). Does nothing when Chef is not installed or already running. Writes chef_handoff.log into %APPDATA%\Arrowhead\Helldivers2. Needs MDL3 and Chef Shared Loader 1.2.0 or newer, with MDL3 deployed ABOVE Chef.
